mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% (rolling 1-year window).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks escalate.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns with Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 indicates manufacturing sector weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly job growth exceeding 100.0 thousand persons consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100.0 (thousand persons).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1000.0 thousand units signal housing market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence declines.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST is below 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 230.0 and FEDFUNDS below 1.0% signal stagflation risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: The joint condition CPIAUCSL>230.0 and FEDFUNDS<1.0 fails to predict negative SPX returns with Rank IC < 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of declining retail sales signal consumer sector weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during late-cycle slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS declines for two consecutive months.
